Services FAQ

01

Which service page should I open first?

Match the job type—panel upgrade, EV charger, outlet repair, or commercial electrician. City pages layer local permitting notes on the same services.

02

Can one call cover multiple scopes?

Yes—describe everything on the line. Dispatch assigns a Red Seal lead and notes ESA / utility steps for the full list.

03

How do I book?

Pick the closest service card, note the page topic, and call 1-800-POWER-CA with your address and photos.
